meta.promptText: I want to buy a sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast on Indian skin. Which one is best?

response.text:
When choosing a sunscreen for Indian skin tones, the primary goal is finding lightweight, high-protection formulas (SPF 50, PA++++) that use advanced chemical filters or ultra-micronized ingredients to completely eliminate the dreaded grey/ashy white cast.[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-sunscreen-for-indian-skin-no-white-cast#:~:text=After%20all%20that%20testing%2C%20here%20are%20the,zero%20white%20cast%20even%20on%20NC50%20skin.)

Top options tailored to different skin needs include:

The Re'Equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch Sunscreen Gel Spf 50 Pa++++ is the **gold standard for oily or acne-prone skin**, offering a velvety, sweat-resistant finish with zero white cast.

The Minimalist SPF 50 Sunscreen 50g acts like a **lightweight moisturizer with added vitamins**, blending seamlessly into the skin for a natural, non-shiny look.

The Aqualogica Glow + Dewy Sunscreen With Papaya & Vitamin C SPF 50+ PA++ is ideal for **dry to normal skin types**, utilizing a water-light gel texture that provides a healthy, glowing finish without any residue.

The The Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel Spf 50 Pa++++ delivers **deep hydration** via hyaluronic acid while absorbing quickly into a completely invisible finish.
